claim: For operating income, Adobe topped $2.6 billion for the first time in the fiscal Q1 period of 2026.
summary: The claim asserts Adobe's GAAP or non-GAAP operating income exceeded $2.6B in FY Q1 2026 for the first time. No tools are available and the model's knowledge cutoff (2026-01-04) precedes the full reporting of Adobe's FY2026 Q1 (Dec 2025-Feb 2026), so neither the Q1 2026 value nor the historical 'first time' history can be verified from internal knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Adobe's operating income topped $2.6 billion in fiscal Q1 2026
sub_claims.stated_text: topped $2.6 billion for the first time in the fiscal Q1 period of 2026
sub_claims.note: No tool access to Adobe SEC filings/earnings releases; Q1 FY2026 occurs after/around knowledge cutoff and cannot be verified internally.

sub_claims.text: Adobe had never reported operating income above $2.6 billion in any period prior to fiscal Q1 2026
sub_claims.note: Requires complete historical review of all prior quarterly and annual operating income figures, which is not available without tools and not established in model knowledge.
